cards.text: Back in the garden, Peter, one of Jesus’ disciples, swung a sword, and Jesus told him to put it away (John 18:10-11). Now the soldiers, their commander and the officers of the Jews arrest Jesus and bind Him. Friend, they tie up the One who just stepped right up and told them He was the one they were looking for (John 18:4-5).

cards.question: The soldiers bring Jesus first to ___, the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.

cards.text: Now, friend, this Caiaphas already gave the Jews some advice, and it was about one man and the people.

cards.question: What had Caiaphas, the high priest that year, advised the Jews?

answers.text: It would be better if one man died for the people
It would be better if one man ruled the people
It would be better if one man spoke for the people

cards.text: Meanwhile, Simon Peter and another disciple are following Jesus. That other disciple is known to the high priest, so he walks right into the high priest’s courtyard with Jesus like his name is on the guest list.

cards.question: True or false: While the other disciple goes into the courtyard with Jesus, Peter stands outside at the door.

cards.text: Then the other disciple talks to the doorkeeper and brings Peter in, like a coworker swiping you in when you forgot your badge. Then the servant girl watching the door looks at Peter and asks, “Aren’t you also one of this man’s disciples?”

cards.question: How does Peter answer the servant girl at the door when she asks if he’s one of Jesus’ disciples?
Inside, the servants and officers stand around a charcoal fire they made, because it is ___.

cards.text: And standing right there with them, warming himself, is PETER. He just told the servant girl at the door he is NOT a disciple, and I think this one hurts.

cards.question: Meanwhile, the high priest questions Jesus about His disciples and His ___.

cards.text: “I have spoken openly to the world,” Jesus answers. He taught in the synagogues and at the temple, where all the Jews come together, and He says He said nothing in secret.

cards.question: Jesus said nothing in secret. So who does He tell the high priest to ask about what He said?

cards.text: That’s when one of the officers standing nearby slaps Jesus in the face. And he says, “Is this how You answer the high priest?”

cards.question: How does Jesus answer the officer who slapped Him?

answers.text: He asks why He was struck if He spoke correctly
He stays silent and looks away from him
He asks the high priest to have him removed

cards.text: Then Annas sends Jesus, still bound, to Caiaphas the high priest. And back at the fire, Peter is STILL standing there warming himself, when they ask him if he’s one of Jesus’ disciples too.

cards.question: True or false: Standing by the fire, Peter finally admits he’s one of Jesus’ disciples.

cards.text: Then one of the high priest’s servants steps up. He’s a relative of the man whose ear Peter cut off, and he asks, “Didn’t I see you with Him in the garden?”

cards.question: The high priest’s servant asks if he saw Peter with Jesus in the garden, and Peter denies it once more. What happens immediately?

cards.text: Three denials before the rooster crowed, just like Jesus told Peter back at supper (John 13:38). Hang on to that rooster, friend, because this story has a whole lot more to tell.
